items.distractor_fact: Kaimyniniame mieste tą pačią naktį oras buvo {D}°C.
items.gloss_en: In the neighboring town, the weather that same night was {D}°C. Bare digit followed by the invariant symbol °C, matching the story's own construction.
items.entity_note: A different town's temperature reading, not the story's own thermometer.

items.distractor_fact: Kitos bendrovės akcijų kaina tą pačią dieną buvo {D}€.
items.gloss_en: Another company's stock price that same day was {D}€. Digit+€ construction, invariant for any integer.
items.entity_note: A different company's share price, not the security in the story.

items.distractor_fact: Kitame tvenkinyje vandens lygis tą pačią dieną buvo {D} m.
items.gloss_en: In another pond, the water level that same day was {D} m. Digit+m construction, the symbol never inflects.
items.entity_note: A different pond's water level, not the one in the story.

items.distractor_fact: Kito skyriaus pajamos per tą patį mėnesį buvo {D}€.
items.gloss_en: Another department's income for the same month was {D}€. Digit+€ construction, invariant for any integer.
items.entity_note: A different department's income, not the one whose net result is asked about.

items.distractor_fact: Kitos komandos įmuštų įvarčių skaičius per sezoną buvo {D} įv.
items.gloss_en: Another team's number of goals scored during the season was {D} goals. Fixed abbreviation 'įv.' never inflects after a numeral.
items.entity_note: A different team's goals scored, not the team the question is about.

items.distractor_fact: Kito investuotojo pelnas per tą patį ketvirtį buvo {D}€.
items.gloss_en: Another investor's profit for the same quarter was {D}€. Digit+€ construction, invariant for any integer.
items.entity_note: A different investor's gain, not the investor in the story.

items.distractor_fact: Kitas cechas per tą patį mėnesį pagamino {D} vnt.
items.gloss_en: Another workshop produced {D} units during the same month. Fixed abbreviation 'vnt.' never inflects after a numeral.
items.entity_note: A different workshop's own actual output, whose own plan figure is not stated, so it cannot be confused with this workshop's plan-vs-actual pair.

items.distractor_fact: Kito filialo pardavimų rezultatas per tą patį mėnesį buvo {D}€.
items.gloss_en: Another branch's sales result for the same month was {D}€. Digit+€ construction, invariant for any integer.
items.entity_note: A different branch's sales figure, whose own target is not stated, so it cannot substitute for the branch's actual or target.

items.distractor_fact: Kitoje stotyje tą pačią parą kritulių kiekis buvo {D} mm.
items.gloss_en: At another station, the rainfall amount during the same day was {D} mm. Digit+mm construction, invariant for any integer.
items.entity_note: A different weather station's rainfall reading, whose own forecast is not stated.

items.distractor_fact: Kito žaidėjo smūgių skaičius kitame ruože buvo {D}.
items.gloss_en: Another player's stroke count on a different hole was {D}. Bare-predicate pattern ('skaičius buvo {D}') with no following noun to govern, so any integer is grammatical.
items.entity_note: A different player's stroke count, on a hole whose par is not stated, so it cannot be paired with the story's stated par.

items.distractor_fact: Kito žaidėjo bendras smūgių skaičius per visą turą buvo {D}.
items.gloss_en: Another player's total stroke count for the whole round was {D}. Bare-predicate pattern, invariant for any integer.
items.entity_note: A different player's round total, not tied to this hole's stated par, and distinct from the player in the story.

items.distractor_fact: Kitos linijos traukinio faktinis atvykimo laikas buvo {D} min nuo paros pradžios.
items.gloss_en: Another line's train's actual arrival time was {D} min from the start of the day. Invariant abbreviation 'min' never inflects after a numeral.
items.entity_note: A different train on a different line, whose own schedule is not stated, so it cannot be paired with this train's stated schedule.

items.distractor_fact: Kitame pastate lifto ekrane rodomas aukšto numeris buvo {D}.
items.gloss_en: In another building, the floor number shown on the elevator display was {D}. Bare-predicate pattern ('numeris buvo {D}'), invariant for any integer.
items.entity_note: A different building's elevator floor number, whose own reference floor is not stated.

items.distractor_fact: Trečios komandos įvarčių skaičius kitose rungtynėse buvo {D}.
items.gloss_en: A third team's goal count in a different match was {D}. Bare-predicate pattern, invariant for any integer.
items.entity_note: A third team not involved in the Team A vs Team B comparison.

items.gloss_en: A third company's profit indicator was {D}%. Digit+% construction, invariant for any integer.
items.entity_note: A third company not involved in the Company X vs Company Y comparison.

items.distractor_fact: Trečio žygeivio aukštis virš jūros lygio buvo {D} m.
items.gloss_en: A third hiker's altitude above sea level was {D} m. Digit+m construction, invariant for any integer.
items.entity_note: A third hiker not involved in the hiker A vs hiker B comparison.
